page_title: VAL 0-0 SEV | Valencia v Sevilla 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Quique Sanchez Flores decides to make a substitution. Jesus Navas will be replaced by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).
90+4' We are about to witness a substitution. Hannibal Mejbri (Sevilla) is replacing Oliver Torres.
90+2' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Pepelu (Valencia), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

87' What a chance that is! Alejo Veliz (Sevilla) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
86' Ruben Baraja prepares a substitution. Hugo Guillamon is replaced by Alberto Mari (Valencia).
86' Substitution. Alejo Veliz (Sevilla) on for Isaac Romero.
85' Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) makes a strong challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul. Sevilla will take a free kick near the side line.
84' Wasted opportunity. Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
84' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Kike Salas (Sevilla) commits a foul after dangerous play. Valencia will take a free kick.
79' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Loic Bade (Sevilla), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
78' Neat passing move from Valencia in order to create new attacking opportunities.
75' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
74' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
73' Substitution. Fran Perez walks off the pitch and Javi Guerra (Valencia) comes on as a substitute.
72' Here is a change. Roman Yaremchuk is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).
70' The referee signals a substitution. Suso (Sevilla) is brought on as a substitute for Djibril Sow.
70' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
67' Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
66' 12:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
63' Substitution. Sergi Canos leaves the pitch and is replaced by Peter Gonzalez (Valencia).
61' Kike Salas (Sevilla) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
59' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
58' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' Orjan Nyland comes off his line to intercept the corner from Pepelu (Valencia).

53' Orjan Nyland was forced into action to thwart Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
49' Hugo Duro (Valencia) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
49' Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.

47' Orjan Nyland makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Sergi Canos (Valencia) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of inside the left post.
46' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marcos Acuna.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Sergi Canos (Valencia) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
41' PENALTY APPEAL after Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
40' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
40' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Valencia will take a corner kick.
36' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) meets a cross inside the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
34' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

33' A lofted cross from Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman signals a throw-in for Sevilla.
29' Fran Perez (Valencia) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
28' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
25' Fran Perez (Valencia) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
23' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:0.

19' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. His dangerous effort is blocked by Orjan Nyland, who makes a glorious save!
17' Valencia control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
14' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
13' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) tries to find Oliver Torres, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
11' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball has crossed the sideline. Valencia are taking a throw-in.
9' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
6' Sergi Canos (Valencia) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
6' Valencia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

5' Sergi Canos (Valencia) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Orjan Nyland pulls off an easy save.

1' Fran Perez (Valencia) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
